package soak

// PLANT: an unclosed sql.Rows on requests 501-504 (after the baseline). database/sql keeps the
// connection checked out until Rows.Close, so the pool never gets it back. Capped
// at 4 (of 8) so the run keeps working and the failure is attributable.
// Expected: oracle (b) db_in_use FAIL.

import (
	"database/sql"
	"net/http"
	"sync"
	"sync/atomic"
)

func init() {
	handlerWrappers = append(handlerWrappers, func(next http.Handler, env *soakEnv) http.Handler {
		var n atomic.Int64
		var mu sync.Mutex
		var held []*sql.Rows
		plantCleanups = append(plantCleanups, func() {
			mu.Lock()
			defer mu.Unlock()
			for _, r := range held {
				_ = r.Close()
			}
		})
		return http.HandlerFunc(func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
			if c := n.Add(1); c > 500 && c <= 504 { // after warm-up: the baseline is taken by now
				// No context, no Next, no Close: the leak.
				rows, err := env.sqlDB.Query("SELECT 1") //nolint:rowserrcheck,sqlclosecheck // the plant
				if err == nil {
					mu.Lock()
					held = append(held, rows)
					mu.Unlock()
				}
			}
			next.ServeHTTP(w, r)
		})
	})
}
